name: Fujisaki Ai
source: Alias "Steel Shelled Ai". The beautiful top-rank police investigator leading Team One of O.C.S.A.T, an armed special force countering organized crime. Her body is enhanced with nano machines giving her superhuman abilities and the ability to metalize her limbs as weapons.
